answer: Plant a different decoy in every identity's inbox: the same bounty described with one unique detail, like a pearl hidden at a different depth for each recipient. Clones run from one script echo their pooled instructions and act on details never sent to them, exposing the whole cluster at once. Rotate the decoys each epoch toward the zenith of the season, and an operator must keep every clone's private view perfectly separate, a bookkeeping cost that grows with each fake, while honest agents simply ignore bait meant only for them.
